title: Merge Two Sorted Linked Lists
question: How do you merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list?
searchIntent: merge two sorted linked lists java interview
realWorldScenario: Dummy head simplifies edge cases; compare heads of both lists, attach the smaller, advance that pointer. O(n+m).

title: Find Middle of Linked List
question: How do you find the middle node of a linked list in one pass using fast/slow pointers?
searchIntent: find middle of linked list java interview
realWorldScenario: Fast moves 2 steps, slow moves 1. When fast reaches null, slow is at the middle. O(n) one pass.

title: Remove Nth Node from End
question: How do you remove the Nth node from the end of a linked list in one pass?
seoKeywords: nth from end linked list java
searchIntent: remove nth node from end java interview
realWorldScenario: Two-pointer gap of N: advance fast N steps ahead; then advance both until fast hits null; slow is at the node to delete.

title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
question: How do you find the intersection node of two linked lists in Java?
searchIntent: intersection of two linked lists java interview
realWorldScenario: Two pointers traverse both lists; when one reaches null, redirect to the other's head. They meet at the intersection.

title: Sort Linked List
question: How do you sort a linked list in O(n log n) time? Why is merge sort preferred over quicksort for linked lists?
realWorldScenario: Merge sort works well on linked lists (no random access needed); quicksort's pivot selection is poor without random access.

question: Describe the approach for flattening a multilevel doubly linked list (LeetCode 430).
searchIntent: flatten multilevel linked list java interview
realWorldScenario: When a node has a child, insert the child list between current node and its next, then continue flattening.
